accountingReview: Owner capital and drawings belong to proprietor equity; do not treat drawings as business expense.
Bank-to-bank transfers are not income or expenses.
Employee imprest advances are current assets until substantiated and settled.
GST input credit subject to eligibility and supporting invoices; keep CGST SGST IGST separate.
TDS receivable current asset, TDS deducted from vendor payments generally liability until deposited.
Fixed assets capitalized only where recognition criteria met; separate depreciation and repairs.
Record vouchers with balanced debit and credit lines, immutable IDs, audit log and reversals.
Do not automatically post bank imports or infer GST/TDS from narration.
Maintain distinct divisions as cost centres, not separate legal entities.
